opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; not required for all working group members. Groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: You will be able to claim the first five years' worth of funding in year 1, which is £3,500... in the sixth year, you can claim an additional £3,500.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners (Reserve Managers, consultants) and university academics. Awards are to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies taking place anywhere in the world, funding the annual cost of a few days of data gathering over a long period (~£500/year) for projects such as ecological restoration, habitat creation, control of alien species and climate change.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. No geographical restrictions; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level (early years to life-long learning). Awards are to individuals, not organisations. Projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning, funding research on education methods within ecology to inform teaching and learning practices.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations. Must have employer/supervisor approval and a willing host organisation. Undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, providing an immersive interdisciplinary secondment experience for ecologists (up to 12 months).

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES membership required. Funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. Does not cover principal researcher salary, bench fees, or departmental vehicle hire. Not a scholarship.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, supporting work with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership. Awards open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels. No restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out outreach work. Projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science and careers.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (currently registered on a postgraduate research degree programme). Postdocs, undergraduates and masters students not eligible. Must work/study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences. Next round opens 24 August 2026.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must be travelling from and returning to the Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering costs directly related to attending the meeting such as registration, transport, food and accommodation. Open 17 July - 8 September 2026.
